notes.title: Requesting reviews for our booty game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622194/36944f42f3387e56bfaac542650edb47a30044b3.png[/img]

Help! I've Been Cursed With a Bubble Butt (HIBCWABB) is officially live on Steam! HIBCWABB is a fun, short game that you can play alone or stream with your friends and is chock full of butt puns. Thank you to those who left your juicy reviews on itch.io.  

We're coming to you with another ask...[b]would you be one of our first ten reviews on Steam?[/b]

Ten reviews is what it takes for Steam to recommend HIBCWABB to new people, so during our launch week, from now until June 6th, we're offering a 10% discount to all players. 

It would make us so happy if you could give us a lift.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725510/Help_Ive_Been_Cursed_With_a_Bubble_Butt/][b]Buy HIBCWABB for $2.69 here![/b][/url]

Thanks!

Kyle, Ceren and CJ
